name: F870
summary: Industrial FDM platform for manufacturing environments.

page.description: Stratasys F870 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: Large-format FDM,
page.lead: A 1,000 × 610 × 610 mm chamber heated to 95 °C, integrated material drying and four 4,100 cm³ spools with automatic changeover, so tooling, fixtures and end-of-arm tools print in-house, unattended for up to two weeks†.
page.footnote: † Stratasys claim (up to). Source: stratasys.com F870 page, read 10 Nov 2026.

features.title: Integrated material drying
features.text: Regenerative drying bays keep filament print-ready.

features.title: 4,100 cm³ spools
features.text: Four spools with automatic changeover, shared with the F3300.

features.title: Three print heads
features.text: N14 for detail, N20H for Nylon 12CF, N25 for up to 2× ASA throughput (Stratasys claim).

benefits.title: In-house tooling
benefits.text: Make fixtures and EOAT on site instead of outsourcing machining.

benefits.title: Long unattended runs
benefits.text: Up to two weeks between material changes (Stratasys claim).

benefits.title: Lower total cost
benefits.text: Fewer failed builds and less operator labour.

benefits.title: Scalable materials
benefits.text: Nine materials at launch on a spool format shared with the F3300.

specs.label: Throughput
specs.value: N14 up to 25 cm³/h · N20H up to 21 cm³/h · N25 up to 66 cm³/h (Stratasys figures)

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: XY ±0.254 mm or ±0.002 mm/mm; Z ±0.200 mm or ±0.002 mm/mm, plus 1 layer height (whichever is greater, 95 % dimensional yield)

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: FDM Nylon 12CF, ABS-M30 Black, FDM ASA (White, Ivory, Light Gray, Black, Red, Yellow), FDM ABS Draft (Gray)

specs.label: Material delivery
specs.value: 4 × 4,100 cm³ spools, automatic changeover, integrated drying

specs.label: Power
specs.value: 3-phase, 208 V, 30 A; no shop air needed (integrated vacuum pump)

specs.label: Operating conditions
specs.value: 15–30 °C, 30–70 % RH; 99 cm clearance on each side

page.applications_heading: The tools your production line needs, made on site.
page.applications_text: End-of-arm tooling, fixtures, gauges and ergonomic aids, printed in hours and replaced as the line changes.

applications.title: End-of-arm tooling
applications.text: Lightweight Nylon 12CF replacements for machined aluminium.

applications.title: Fixtures, jigs and gauges
applications.text: Assembly fixtures and check gauges made in-house.

applications.title: Ergonomic aids
applications.text: Operator-specific hand tools and lift assists.
